decisive_spans.text: Mantoux tuberculin skin test showed 10 mm
Sputum induction for acid-fast bacilli was negative
bronchoalveolar lavage was negative for Xpert® Mycobacterium tuberculosis/rifampicin assay

response.rationale: Sarcoidosis is strongly supported by the persistent dry cough, weight loss, multifocal consolidations, and negative infectious workup, including negative TB tests and lack of response to antibiotics and anti-tuberculosis therapy. Organizing pneumonia is a runner-up due to the consolidations and lack of response to antibiotics, but sarcoidosis better explains the full clinical picture including the negative infectious workup and persistent symptoms despite TB treatment.
